messages:
incident-bot: :loud_sound: Pager P1: sustained error-rate spike for dedicated pool 'dedicated-eu-03' on /v1/chat.stream (error metric: downstream_5xx_rate > 2.5% over 8m). Runbook: https://wiki.redwood.internal/incidents/dedicated-5xx

Priya (oncall): noticed. Is this correlated with a deployment or autoscale event?

Sam (sre): no deploys in window. Autoscaler shows scale-up thrashing earlier, then plateau. Could be model memory pressure triggering worker restarts.

Noah (infra): I can flip on transient burst capacity for the pool. Current: autoscale.min=12, max=48, burst_capacity=80. Propose temp burst_capacity=240 with burst_mode="elastic" for 20m to absorb spike.

Rina (serving): before increasing burst, can we add short-term request shaping? We should limit expensive endpoints (rerank, embeddings) and prioritize low-cost chat.generations.

Priya (oncall): agreed. Plan: 1) enable burst 2) apply traffic-shape rules to deprioritize rerank/embeddings on that pool 3) add per-tenant short quota for free-tier 4) monitor for 10m and consider partial failover to dedicated-eu-04 if needed.

Noah (infra): executing burst toggle: ```rbctl pool set --name dedicated-eu-03 --burst-capacity 240 --burst-ttl 20m --strategy elastic --initiator priya.oncall```

incident-bot: Pool update requested by noah (op id: op-112233). Status: in-progress.

Sam (sre): adding traffic-shaping rule now: ```trafficctl shape add --pool dedicated-eu-03 --match "endpoint:rerank OR endpoint:embeddings" --priority low --rate-limit 0.2rps --duration 25m --note "mitigate 5xx spike"``` Applying.

Omar (support): sending customer comms to impacted accounts. Two mid-market customers reported production errors to support. I'll include a suggested mitigation: stagger batch jobs and reduce seq_length.

Priya (oncall): also apply per-tenant quota for non-prod tenants: ```quotactl set --pool dedicated-eu-03 --filter "env!=prod" --quota 1000calls/hr --duration 30m --reason "emergency mitigation"```

Rina (serving): rolling a conservative config change to reduce per-session KV-cache allocation: ```cfgctl update --pool dedicated-eu-03 --key serving.max_kv_per_session --value 48 --canary 3``` Doing canary across 3 nodes.

incident-bot: Canary deployment started (3/30 nodes) 30  metrics expected in ~40s.

Sam (sre): 5xx trending down: 2.6% -> 1.4% over 6m. Worker restarts reduced. Burst pool came up fine.

Noah (infra): FYI burst-capacity increase will cause short-term allocation of GPUs from shared infra; cost center flagged as "emergency". I've made a note in the billing audit.

Priya (oncall): nice. Keep monitoring. If we see another rise >2% for 10m, we'll trigger controlled spillover: move 15% traffic to dedicated-eu-04 and enable degraded mode (disable rerank feature flag). Noah, prepare the split but don't enable yet.

Noah (infra): prepared the command, queued: ```rbctl traffic split --from dedicated-eu-03 --to dedicated-eu-04 --percent 15 --auto-enable false --reason "spillover if errors persist"``` Ready.

Omar (support): CC-ing SEs, customers acknowledged temporary throttles. One asked for ETA; reply: "we expect improved stability within 20-30m, we'll follow up with post-incident details."

Rina (serving): logs show two tenants with abnormally long sessions and high token windows. Will gather request IDs and add to postmortem. Also proposing autoscaler policy change: add scale-on-kv-pressure metric and a relaxed cooldown to avoid thrash.

Sam (sre): agree on autoscaler tweak. For now, warning: if we leave burst at 240 too long, it might mask root cause and increase cost. Let's set TTL to 20m and reassess after canary results.

incident-bot: Reminder scheduled in 12m to reassess pool dedicated-eu-03.

Priya (oncall): handoff: I'll be on other page in 18m. Sam takes primary if it resurfaces. Sam, confirm you can take escalation.

Sam (sre): confirmed. I'll escalate to infra lead if >1.8% 5xx sustained for 12m.

Noah (infra): burst toggle completed, pool now burst_capacity=240 (ttl 20m). Canary config applied. Traffic shaping rule active.

Priya (oncall): final update before stepping away: burst=240 ttl=20m, rerank/embeddings deprioritized, non-prod quota set, KV-cache canary on 3 nodes, spillover prepared. 5xx at 1.2% and falling. Leaving to Sam. :white_check_mark:

Sam (sre): will update thread if anything changes. Thanks everyone.

incident-bot: Incident P1 acknowledged by priya, assigned to sam.
